purpose: Teach: 内戦/銃撃/ラテン語/追い出さ/置き去り/煽っ/潰さ/吸い込ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外、内戦リスクの地域で慎重に進めろ
lines.en: Move carefully in overseas regions with civil-war risk.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Each word lands with weight. No softening. Direct eye contact, steady posture. The tone of someone issuing a directive that will be followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外、銃撃事件多発地域はリスク管理します
lines.en: Understood. We'll manage the risk in high-violence areas overseas.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Voice steady and clear. Slight nod — acknowledging both the order and the seriousness. Measured pace, no rushing to prove competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ラテン語由来の商品名を検討しろ
lines.en: Consider product names with Latin roots for the company.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the core instruction. Not commanding so much as suggesting direction. Lean back slightly — this is strategic thinking, not urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、市場から追い出されないよう努めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll ensure the company doesn't get pushed out of the market.
lines.style: Affirmation with quiet confidence. Breath settles at the period. Voice carries understated commitment — not performative, just present. Professional intimacy of two people aligned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様を置き去りにする経営はするな
lines.en: Don't run the company in a way that abandons customers.
lines.style: Firmer edge now. Not lecturing — more like drawing a line. Slight emphasis on the negation. Weight behind it, but no anger. The tone of someone setting a principle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告で過度に消費を煽った例を反省します
lines.en: Understood. We reflect on cases where advertising pushed consumption too aggressively.
lines.style: Humble acknowledgment of misstep. Slight vocal reduction — not shame, but genuine recalibration. Slower pace. The sound of someone taking responsibility without excuses.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合に潰されないよう戦略を立てろ
lines.en: Build a strategy so competitors don't crush us.
lines.style: Brisk, almost tactical. Strategic urgency — not panic, but real. Forward lean in the voice. Shorter phrases stacked with intent.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、トレンドに吸い込まれない芯を持ちます
lines.en: Understood. The company will maintain its core values and not get swept up in trends.
lines.style: Resolute closer. Voice settles into conviction. Quiet strength — this is the moment where understanding becomes commitment. Steady, no waver.
